exposure: Apgar score at five minutes between zero and three
cohort: 767 newborns born preterm (<37 weeks gestation) and 1,534 newborns born at term (≥37 weeks gestation).
finding: Maternal age under 19 or over 34, inadequate maternal schooling, multiple pregnancies, C-section delivery, low birth weight, low Apgar score at five minutes, and inadequate prenatal care were significantly associated with prematurity.
gest_age: Preterm defined as <37 weeks gestation, Term defined as ≥37 weeks gestation
birth_weight: Birth weight <2500g was associated with prematurity
